parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces vlan unit 2 family inet a.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces vlan unit 2 family inet a.command: set interfaces vlan unit 2 family inet address 192.168.1.12/24
set interfaces vlan unit 2 family inet a.explanation: 配置VLAN接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ae10 unit 0 family ethern.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching interface-mode [parameter3]
set interfaces ae10 unit 0 family ethern.command: set interfaces ae10 unit 0 family ethernet-switching interface-mode trunk
set interfaces ae10 unit 0 family ethern.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换模式为trunk。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ae10 unit 0 family ethern.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching vlan members [parameter3]
set interfaces ae10 unit 0 family ethern.command: set interfaces ae10 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members 2

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

parameters.name: vlan-members
parameters.explanation: VLAN成员ID，表示该接口属于哪个VLAN。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 ether-options 80.explanation: 配置接口的以太网选项，将其加入到链路聚合组中。

parameters.name: aggregated-interface
parameters.explanation: 链路聚合组的名称，例如ae10。
